question: 2025年5月（传统促销月）与2月（淡季）相比：两个月的非取消订单销售额分别是多少，订单量分别是多少，5月销售额相当于2月的多少倍？
gold_sql: WITH may AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_amount) AS rev FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND order_date <= '2025-05-31' AND status != 'cancelled'), feb AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_amount) AS rev FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-02-01' AND order_date <= '2025-02-28' AND status != 'cancelled') SELECT ROUND(m.rev, 2) AS may_revenue, m.cnt AS may_orders, ROUND(f.rev, 2) AS feb_revenue, f.cnt AS feb_orders, ROUND(m.rev / f.rev, 2) AS may_to_feb_ratio FROM may m, feb f
pred_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-05' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sales_may, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-02' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sales_feb, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-05' THEN o.id END) AS orders_may, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-02' THEN o.id END) AS orders_feb, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-05' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-02' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sales_ratio FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND (strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-05' OR strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2025-02')
